    Fast block-diagonal matrix-vector product (replaces X_block %*% beta_bd)

    dot-Xbeta_blockdiag.Rd

    For block-diagonal X_block and coefficient vector beta_bd, computes X_block %*% beta_bd by iterating over J0 unit blocks rather than performing the full sparse matrix-vector product. For K=1 each block reduces to a scalar multiply-and-assign, avoiding sparse matrix overhead.

    .Xbeta_blockdiag(beta_bd, row_ranges, X_block, K, J0, N_stacked)

    Arguments

    beta_bd

    Numeric vector length K*J0.

    row_ranges

    List of J0 integer vectors: row indices per unit block.

    X_block

    Sparse block-diagonal Matrix [N_stacked x K*J0].

    K

    Integer. Covariates per unit.

    J0

    Integer. Number of treated units.

    N_stacked

    Integer. Total rows in X_block.

    Value

    Numeric vector length N_stacked.
